comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Hello. I put together a list of equipment on Increase special shot effects which has a version of this EX Effect skill that does NOT work in PVP conditions. But I don't actually own any of the equipment in that list, so it's possible I misplaced them. If so... oops.

Do you know of any equipment (and its rank level) that actually belongs here? Please do add it, and I'll adjust the list on the other page as necessary/possible. My apologies for the trouble, and thank you in advance. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you either way.

comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: Hi Guilder, I was told the special shot effects DO indeed work for PVP. I have tested this and it seems to be true but I need further testing. The melee increase ex supposedly don't work on Japanese server either for pvp, but it does here on Maris and on other servers such as Korean.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Thanks. I figured if they worked for PVP then their in-game EX Effect description would not have the 'does not work in PVP' note attached. Pending confirmation of that, then the other article's comment section can be relocated here.

comments.body: Executioner's Sword (R13) - this sword look/picture needs update.

comments.author: BOND
comments.body:
Increases the chance of triggering the effects of Smoke Shells, Incendiary Shots and Chain Shots. The chance increases according to Rank.

Smoke shells' effect : Lowers hit rate and disrupt loading
Incendiary Shot' effect : Causes fire and ignite munitions
Chain Shots' effect : Damages sail and rudder
